m88_overlap_attribution.conclusion: The 1.409x comparison is predominantly the PWP compute mechanism; the modeled double-buffer preparation overlap contributes about 1.0089x versus the derived same-work serial schedule.

risks.finding: No exact target SRAM macro, Liberty DB, timing, or energy view is present.
risks.mitigation: Keep 512x32 1RW behind a replaceable wrapper and perform same-macro DC/PTPX before PPA claims.

risks.finding: M86-R3 is serial and M88's two slots are analytical only.
risks.mitigation: Pass M98A lockstep, then implement M98B and require actual-record overlap covers.

risks.finding: M85 owns one active metadata image and cannot accept next-phase metadata during active compute.
risks.mitigation: Store per-slot metadata and charge one explicit M85 activation cycle after drain.

risks.finding: M86-R3 enforces 128 accepts but not the canonical identity/order of those accepts.
risks.mitigation: Add phase sequence plus an explicit ordered descriptor contract and negative VCS attacks.

risks.finding: M88 preparation includes missing record DMA/parser and weight buffers.
risks.mitigation: Limit M98 claims to actual row-ingress overlap until an executable producer is integrated.

risks.finding: 512x32 macros add 3,328 payload bytes over two logical 460-row slots.
risks.mitigation: Report physical rather than logical capacity and revisit only with a qualified compiler option.

risks.finding: M88 identified 51,149 zero-tail row writes per 1,728-phase catalog pass.
risks.mitigation: Keep full-fill equivalence first; evaluate terminal-aware implicit zeros as a later separately verified optimization.

risks.finding: The recommended first revision uses a global reset to recover from any slot fault.
risks.mitigation: Defer slot-local abort until the basic ownership and stale-response proof closes.

risks.finding: ECC, row bitmap, tags, control, and clock-gating energy are outside M88's 116,525-byte subtotal.
risks.mitigation: Include them in later DC/SAIF/PTPX and macro-energy accounting.
